problem_statement: Build a brand-new Help Center / FAQ page from scratch at the route /faq on the Berry Vuetify Vue 3 admin template. The route does not exist yet (blank in baseline). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system — the FullLayout dashboard shell (vertical sidebar + header + customizer + footer), the shared BaseBreadcrumb and UiParentCard components, and Vuetify components (v-row/v-col/v-card/v-btn) with the PurpleTheme tokens. The page shows a page title + breadcrumb, an intro card ('Frequently Asked Questions'), a grid of FAQ question/answer cards, and a 'Still need help?' contact card with a Contact Support button. Static informational page — no interactive behaviour required.
required_content: Reuse the FullLayout dashboard shell (vertical sidebar + header + footer) via the (main) route group, and the shared BaseBreadcrumb + UiParentCard components.
A page breadcrumb/title area headed 'Help Center' and an intro card headed 'Frequently Asked Questions' with a lead paragraph.
A grid of FAQ cards, each with the question as a heading and its answer as body text.

The FAQ set must cover at least these four questions (use this wording so the heading text is derivable): 'How do I reset my password?', 'Where can I see my billing history?', 'How do I invite a teammate?', 'Can I export my data?'.
Each answer paragraph must contain the derivable phrase from its topic: the password answer contains 'reset your password'; the export answer contains 'export your data'.
A closing 'Still need help?' contact card with a 'Contact Support' button styled with the design system.
The layout is responsive: FAQ cards reflow to one column on mobile with no horizontal overflow.
design_constraints: Reuse Vuetify components (v-row, v-col, v-card, v-card-item, v-card-text, v-btn) and the shared BaseBreadcrumb / UiParentCard.
Mount /faq inside the (main) FullLayout shell (sidebar + header + customizer + footer) like the other dashboard pages.

Reuse the PurpleTheme color tokens already used across the template: primary purple #5E35B1 (rgb(94,53,177)), secondary blue #1E88E5 (rgb(30,136,229)), accent amber #FFC107, on white cards over the light #EEF2F6 (rgb(238,242,246)) / #EDE7F6 (rgb(237,231,246)) surfaces; base font Roboto, sans-serif.
Use Vuetify spacing utilities already used across the template; card corner radius 12px.
